pol_mu1_b: Map access is for planning your own trip — yours and, on a family plan, the members it includes. It may not be used for a business, resold, or used to plan trips for paying clients.
pol_mu2_b: Do not copy, export, scrape or republish the places, locations, photos or notes on the map, and do not share your sign-in with anyone else. Screenshots for your own trip are fine; passing them on is not.
pol_mu3_b: Each plan can be used on a limited number of devices, shown on the plan. Signing in on a new device beyond that limit may be refused until you remove a device under My devices in your account.
pol_mu4_b: Paid map views carry a light watermark with your account email and the date. Copying, right-click and printing are turned off on the map.
pol_mu5_b: Unusual activity — many devices, automated access or shared sign-ins — may lead us to suspend map access or the account. Contact us if you believe this happened by mistake.
pol_mu6_b: Places change. Opening hours, prices and access can differ from what the map shows, so check before you make a long drive.
pol_placeholder_b: The wording on this page is being prepared with our legal advisers and is not final. It will be published in full before any booking is taken, and this page will always carry the version that applies to your booking.
pol_platform_scope: Who may use the platform, account responsibilities, acceptable use, reviews and content you submit, and when we may suspend an account.
pol_platform_sub: The rules for using Bali Trips: your account, what you may and may not do, and what happens when the rules are broken.
pol_privacy_scope: The personal data we hold, our basis for processing it, how long we keep it, who it is shared with, and how to request a copy or its deletion.
pol_privacy_sub: What we collect, why we collect it, and the choices you have.
pol_pu1_b: You need to be 18 or older to create an account and book, or have a parent or guardian do it for you. Each account belongs to one person, and the details you give us must be accurate.
pol_pu2_b: Keep your sign-in details to yourself. You are responsible for what happens under your account. We may ask you to verify your email address or mobile number before some features work.
pol_pu3_b: Do not use the platform for anything unlawful, to harass anyone, to post false information, or to disrupt the site. Automated access — bots, scrapers or bulk downloads — is not allowed.
pol_pu4_b: Place details, opening hours and tips are guidance and can change. The price and availability that apply are the ones confirmed at checkout, and every booking follows the terms and conditions and the cancellation and refund policy.
pol_pu5_b: Reviews must describe your own experience. We may decline or remove content that is false, offensive or unrelated to the experience.
pol_pu5_t: Reviews and content you send us
pol_pu6_b: We may limit, suspend or close an account that breaks this policy. If you think we got it wrong, contact us and we will review it.
